race.comment: OVER THE LOUVRE (4) is worth following up fourth-up after being beaten just over a length at the Gold Coast when making the running. The inside draw and race fitness give him a clear platform to break through this time. MR HILTON (3) is the main danger, with his close Ipswich third two runs back stronger than his plain Doomben seventh from metro company last time. TO'O (10) has worked into the campaign, placed at Ballina last start and gets a 1.5kg claim. Gets his chance to put it all together fourth-up. HEAVENLY ARTIST (7) didn't threaten at Eagle Farm last time but this is easier and he could be worth another look.
